verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS email API with SDKs and an MCP server, but the evidence pack has nothing on opting out of Mailgun's own telemetry or usage tracking. The open/click tracking items describe tracking of email recipients' engagement, which is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
